findings.message: This HTML composition file has 863 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on ".gen-hello" for scale between 2.18s and 2.22s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.
findings.snippet: tl.to(".gen-hello", { scale: 1.055, duration: 1.55, ease: "none" }, 0.67) tl.to(".gen-hello", { opacity: 0, y: -65, scale: 1.18, duration: 0.48, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 2.18)

findings.message: Function-valued tween var for x on ".s19-camera" measures layout at tween init, which is deterministic across cold render workers only while the measured layout never animates. Each render worker initializes tweens independently.
findings.fixHint: Compute the value once at build time (before the timeline is registered) and pass a constant, or derive it from fixed composition coordinates.
findings.snippet: tl.to(".s19-camera", { x: () => 1720 - 960 - (container.offsetLeft + container.offsetWidth - 960) * 1.25, scale: 1.25, y: -15, duration: 4, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 0.5)
